learned_patterns.pattern: INTC's manual fractional stop fired correctly between sessions (sold 07-07 @ $109.01, -14.98%, below the $112.06 stop) even though no live CLU session ran — confirming the between-session fractional monitor / intervening-agent path works when fractional_positions.json is current. The wide 12.6% ATR stop still booked a -15% loss, a reminder that high-ATR names (INTC ATR 7.6%) give a wide stop room to run against you.

The Signal Engine has now been dark ~14 days (last matrix 2026-06-30). SAFE MODE has held across the entire gap, so no signal-based entry has been possible for two weeks. The §2.5 staleness guard is doing its job (no trading on stale data), but a two-week outage means the LAB experiment is effectively paused. Firing the workflow_dispatch Signal Engine is the single highest-priority operational fix.

For the second consecutive review, a material position change (this time INTC's exit) surfaced only via broker reconciliation, not from session memory. The discipline holds: always reconcile positions AND recent orders against the broker (§5.1), and treat the broker as truth. Cash deltas must be traced to their cause (sale vs deposit) before routing — the $11 here was sale proceeds, so no deposit-routing triggered.

The INTC stop-out organically pulled LAB from 25.9% to 18.1% — under the 20% cap for the first time — exactly the 'wait for organic exits to reduce an overweight tier' mechanism (§17.3) rather than force-selling. The book now sits near target at 18/50/24 (LAB/CORE/DRIP); DRIP (-5.9pp) is the remaining underweight and the next-deposit target.

Two weeks on, price continues to lead the stale composite: NVDA is +5.87% from entry and rose +4.06% today while its last-known composite is BEARISH (-0.338, Trend50=Down). With a 14-day-old matrix, the composites are not just lagging — they are non-actionable. Do not read a stale BEARISH composite as a live sell signal; it is a frozen snapshot.

Dividend yields render sanely (JEPQ 9.95%, JEPI 8.10%, SCHD 3.30%) but dividend_growth_streak=0 and payout_ratio=null persist, so the §15.3 dividend-growth screen stays unverifiable. Covered-call JEPI/JEPQ (payout N/A by rule) can seed on yield; SCHD/DGRO/VIG/VYM wait on the streak/payout fix.
